Singer Jelly Roll Addresses Political Stance After Trump Comments

Singer Jelly Roll addressed his political views on Jimmy Kimmel Live, clarifying his stance after comments referencing Donald Trump led to him being labeled with both "MAGA" and "snowflake" terms. He stated he is not apolitical and has been "misunderstood." Jelly Roll explained that his past comments were not intended to align him with any specific political party.
